section-intro.name: SectionIntroComponent
section-intro.description:
The opening of a content section, drawn on the `
` it is placed on: an eyebrow, a heading, and intro text, all projected. The `

` before the heading is the eyebrow and the `

` after it the intro text, so whoever places it picks the heading level. The styles reach the projected children, which emulated encapsulation leaves out, so the component turns encapsulation off and scopes every rule to its own selector instead.
